uncertainties.detail: Ross Johnson and Thomas Johnson are highly ambiguous names. Ecuadorian records identify the Rosaprima executive as Thomas Ross Johnson Maya and match the Ecuadorian nationality, executive email, company and role; the immutable record and existing LinkedIn use the shortened Thomas Ross Johnson and Ross Johnson forms. Identity clears 99.

Forbes hosts a profile for a Ross Johnson at Edward Jones in Grand Forks, North Dakota. That adviser is explicitly excluded because geography, sector and age cohort conflict with the Ecuadorian Rosaprima founder. Other Forbes results concern F. Ross Johnson or social-media consultants.

Formal records show Johnson as Rosaprima manager around 2000, executive president by 2013 and still executive president in a 2025 government filing. The founder and chief-executive description remains current on company and professional pages.

Johnson held direct Rosaprima participations in historical filings and transferred them to Thorosami LLC in 2010. The reviewed evidence does not establish the current beneficial owners of that company, Johnson's current personal percentage or the present value of any interest.

Rosaprima's farms, crop varieties, workforce, brand, inventory, customer relationships and revenue belong to the operating company. Founder and executive roles do not justify attributing those corporate assets or their full value to Johnson personally.

Pandora Papers reporting identifies Johnson as a director in an Ithaca Capital structure and says the documents suggest, but do not prove, an investor relationship. Low-tier aggregators list Zaimella board service. Neither is presented as a verified current role or quantified personal holding.

The exact Rosaprima LinkedIn profile already exists in the immutable record and is not reproposed. The official Rosaprima domain is proposed as Company Website; no Instagram or personal website cleared the identity threshold.

The existing biography leads with speculative private-asset attribution and treats Zaimella board service as current without strong verification. The proposed correction replaces those claims with a 53-word, public-safe Rosaprima biography while preserving the immutable baseline.

Both biographies exclude private vessel names and characteristics, cohort position, offshore-vehicle speculation, current personal net worth, unsupported ownership percentages and corporate assets belonging to Rosaprima or other companies.
